articles.title: PM Modi opens North East's first highway airstrip in Assam
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated a highway-based emergency landing facility (ELF) at Moran, Assam's Dibrugarh district. The PM landed on the emergency runway himself, showcasing a significant boost to national infrastructure and strategic readiness. These dual-use facilities are crucial for emergency operations and can serve as alternative airstrips for defence aircraft, enhancing rapid response capabilities in remote areas and strengthening national security.

articles.title: Border dispute with China arose after India recognised Tibet in 1954: CDS
articles.summary: Chief of Defence Staff General Anil Chauhan elucidated the India-China border dispute's origins, tracing it back to India's 1954 recognition of Tibet as part of China, formalized by the Panchsheel Agreement. This historical perspective from the top military official provides crucial insight for understanding the complex roots of the ongoing national security challenge and India's strategic stance on the Line of Actual Control.

articles.title: Getafe pick off Villarreal with perfect battle strategy at the Coliseum
articles.summary: The article highlights the intense competition in Spain's La Liga, detailing Getafe's critical battle to avoid relegation and secure their spot for next season. Concurrently, Villarreal is shown to be in strong contention for a coveted third-place finish, underscoring significant stakes for both teams within the highly competitive football division.

articles.title: US strikes dozens of Islamic State targets in Syria in retaliation for deadly ambush
articles.summary: The US military confirmed striking over 30 Islamic State targets in Syria this month. These retaliatory attacks followed an IS ambush that tragically killed two US soldiers and an American civilian interpreter. This operation highlights the ongoing US commitment to counter-terrorism efforts, demonstrating a firm stance against groups like ISIS and reinforcing the continuous global struggle to protect personnel and degrade extremist capabilities in conflict zones.

articles.title: Today's news and jokes
articles.summary: A maintenance technician at the National Cathedral was observed using a GoPro to inspect frozen water within the building's gargoyles. This innovative approach ensures thorough inspection of ice-related damage, critical for structural preservation, even as the frozen elements were noted to enhance the gargoyles' formidable appearance. This highlights practical technology use in safeguarding national heritage.

articles.title: Modi mounts fierce attack on Congress, positions ‘new Assam’ as BJP’s 2026 battle cry
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi recently criticized the Congress party while projecting a transformed and confident Assam. Speaking at an event, PM Modi highlighted the state's significant progress, attributing it to ongoing developmental efforts. His remarks underscored the government's vision for Assam's future, emphasizing stability and growth, as he contrasted the current scenario with past administrations.

articles.title: (THE GIST OF PIB) Remount and Veterinary Corps
articles.summary: This specialized Indian Army Corps is vital for military operations, focusing on the breeding, rearing, and training of Army animals. It manages indispensable assets like horses, mules, and Army dogs, ensuring their readiness and effectiveness in diverse operational roles. This dedication supports various logistical and combat functions across different terrains.

articles.title: chuk-mcp-maritime-archives added to PyPI
articles.summary: A comprehensive Model Context Protocol (MCP) server is being developed to facilitate querying historical maritime archives. This system provides detailed access to past shipping records, vessel specifications, crew muster rolls, and cargo manifests. Its purpose is to streamline research and analysis of historical seafaring and trade, leveraging advanced technology for efficient data retrieval and management, offering valuable insights into maritime history.
